readiness_effect: This compatibility-named input is diagnostic-only. A non-placeholder replacement may satisfy a legacy store-track condition, but it cannot establish candidate or release readiness. Candidate readiness belongs to the future source-bound mobile candidate checker, and release authority remains external.

legacy_diagnostic_requires: store or enterprise track name and submission/build identifier
signed binary digest, signing identity, runtime version, and update channel
store metadata approval or release-authority disposition tied to the submitted build

future_candidate_checker_inputs: Google Play internal or closed-track build certification
enterprise MDM release certification when applicable
signed binary digest and runtime version evidence
store metadata approval or release-authority disposition
notes: This file intentionally does not claim store-track certification.
It exists so mobile-test can retain the legacy diagnostic location while showing the current static-scaffold posture.
Even a fully populated replacement remains non-authoritative until evaluated by the future source-bound mobile candidate checker.
